name: @caistech/health-probe
description: External health-probe check ENGINE — the 'what to check and how' for hosted site monitoring. Pure, app-agnostic Check functions (Tier-0: reachability + http_status, lifted from SayFix's runHttpSensor; Tier-1: health_endpoint — GET a health route with an optional read-only Bearer token, expectedStatus, 401/403 = target-config fault) + a runChecks runner + a REGISTRY carrying failure-domain metadata. Zero-dep (native fetch), injectable fetch, never throws (a thrown probe = an unreachable verdict). It does NOT schedule, persist, own tenancy, or create tickets — the consumer's executor does that: SayFix runs it hosted against prod on a cron; portfolio-gate runs it in CI against a preview. Consuming this from your own infra is why the in-repo-CI monitoring model (unshippable to paying clients) is replaced by hosted probes + a registered target.
